Update the gemfire sink to the latest release version by modifying dependency configurations and performing integration testing.
Implement the SFTP source module based on established Spring Cloud Stream module patterns, including adding it to the OOTB module list and publishing to the Maven repository.
Enhance CI pipelines by automating testing and deployment workflows using tools like Jenkins, with configurations for continuous evaluation on every commit.

Third-party dependencies like Hadoop, GemFire, and SFTP libraries are compatible, accessible, and do not require additional licensing fees.
The project scope is limited to the specified user stories, with no additional features or unforeseen technical debt.
The developer has prior experience with Spring Framework, Java, and related technologies, reducing the learning curve for implementation.
The Spring Cloud Data Flow codebase is stable, and changes do not introduce regressions in existing functionalities.
